say:1:1521902001:1.text: Why would you want to end your life?

say:3:1521902003:1.text: How dare you speak to Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> like that?!
say:3:1521902003:1.male: How dare you speak to Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> like that?!
say:3:1521902003:1.female: How dare you speak to Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> like that?!

say:4:1521902004:1.text: If <male>he</male> hadn't used magic to save you, you'd be dead right now!
say:4:1521902004:1.male: If <male>he</male> hadn't used magic to save you, you'd be dead right now!
say:4:1521902004:1.female: If <female>she</female> hadn't used magic to save you, you'd be dead right now!

say:5:1521902005:1.text: That was the whole point. I came here to die.

choice_prompt:6:1521902005.text: That was the whole point. I came here to die.

say:7:1521902006:1.text: <style="highlight">The god and the war took everything from me</style>... I can't go on.

say:9:1521902008:1.text: No. You owe your life to Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. <male>He</male> doesn't want you to die. So you can't.
say:9:1521902008:1.male: No. You owe your life to Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. <male>He</male> doesn't want you to die. So you can't.
say:9:1521902008:1.female: No. You owe your life to Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. <female>She</female> doesn't want you to die. So you can't.

say:10:1521902009:1.text: Are all Wildborn as strange as you?
say:10:1521902009:1.source_cn: 兽人都和你一样奇怪吗？

say:15:1521902012:0.text: The woman shuts her eyes. No matter what you say, she stays silent. Her face is blank, hopeless.
say:15:1521902012:0.source_cn: 女人闭上了双眼。无论你们再问什么，她都闭口不答，一副自...

say:17:1521902013:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do we do now?
say:17:1521902013:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do we do now?
say:17:1521902013:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do we do now?

say:20:1521902015:1.male: If she's from Halia, <style="highlight">the soldiers there might recognize her</style>.
say:20:1521902015:1.female: If she's from Halia, <style="highlight">the soldiers there might recognize her</style>.

choice:18:1:2.male: Let the Halians deal with her.
choice:18:1:2.female: Let the Halians deal with her.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1521903001:.text: Is there any news about Marc—

say:4:1521904001:0.text: Please, don't send me away! I just wanted to know—
say:4:1521904001:0.source_cn: 不要赶我走！我只是想问一下——

say:5:1521904002:0.text: I've told you a hundred times. We haven't heard anything about <style="highlight">your son, Marc</style>.
say:5:1521904002:0.source_cn: 我已经回答你上百遍了，没有<style=highlig...

say:6:1521904003:0.text: Stop bothering us, <style="highlight">Nanri</style>. Or I'll have you arrested for obstructing official duties.
say:6:1521904003:0.source_cn: 不要再来打扰我们的工作了，<style=highlig...

narration:9:15021130:0.text: The suicidal woman tries to ask the Halian soldiers something, but they shout her down.
narration:9:15021130:0.source_cn: 寻死的女人似乎想向呼临城的士兵打听些什么，却被士兵们呵斥。

say:0:1521905001:0.text: Nanri. Got it. Let's ask the guard why she tried to kill herself.
say:0:1521905001:0.source_cn: 原来她叫南茜。正好，可以去问问那个士兵她为什么要寻死。
say:0:1521905001:0.male: Nanri. Got it. Let's ask the guard why she tried to kill herself.
say:0:1521905001:0.female: Nanri. Got it. Let's ask the guard why she tried to kill herself.

say:3:1521906002:0.text: Why should I tell you? Or this little Wildborn?
say:3:1521906002:0.source_cn: 我为什么要告诉你？还有这个小兽人。

say:5:1521906003:0.text: Nanri just tried to end her life. We want to know why.
say:5:1521906003:0.source_cn: 南茜刚才想跳崖寻死。我们只是想知道原因。

say:6:1521906004:0.text: What?! She tried to do that?!

say:7:1521906005:0.source_cn: 唉，最近怎么都是这种麻烦事……

say:8:1521906006:0.text:
Still, thank you for saving her.
She was devastated by the <style="highlight">loss of her son</style>.
say:8:1521906006:0.source_cn: 不管怎么样，谢谢你们救了她。\n<style=high...

say:9:1521906007:0.text: I understand how she feels. <style="highlight">Marc was the only family she had</style>.
say:9:1521906007:0.source_cn: 我能理解她的心情，毕竟<style=highlight...

say:12:1521906009:0.text: No clue. They're not from Halia. Just refugees from another town. Her husband's probably dead.
say:12:1521906009:0.source_cn: 不知道。他们母子俩不是呼临人，是从其他城镇逃难过来的，...

say:13:1521906010:0.text: She and her son had been living here in Halia alone. Then the flood hit. Their home was destroyed... and Marc was swept away.
say:13:1521906010:0.source_cn: 在呼临城住下后，她和她儿子一直相依为命。但洪水冲垮了他...

choice_prompt:14:1521906010.text: She and her son had been living here in Halia alone. Then the flood hit. Their home was destroyed... and Marc was swept away.
choice_prompt:14:1521906010.source_cn: 在呼临城住下后，她和她儿子一直相依为命。但洪水冲垮了他们的房屋……把马可也一起卷走了。

say:15:1521906011:0.text: It is. They never even found his body.
say:15:1521906011:0.source_cn: 是的……连尸体都没有找到。

say:16:1521906012:0.text: Since then, Nanri's been coming here every day, asking if there's any news about his son. It's like she believes he's still alive... It's wearing us all down.
say:16:1521906012:0.source_cn: 从那之后，南茜就老是跑来问我们有没有马可的消息，就好像...

say:17:1521906013:0.text: First famine, then floods. It's already more than we can handle. We just don't have the time or resources to search for a child lost in the disaster.
say:17:1521906013:0.source_cn: 先是饥荒，又是洪水，我们要处理的事太多了，实在没法帮她...

say:18:1521906014:0.text: Sigh... I don't know when she'll finally accept the truth.
say:18:1521906014:0.source_cn: 唉……不知道她什么时候才能接受现实。

cinematic_dialogue:2:1521907001:.text: Please, just look one more time...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1521907002:.text: No! Don't even think about it!

say:4:1521908001:0.source_cn: 别再问我了！问那么多有什么用？！

say:5:1521908002:0.text: You know what happened! That flood wiped out everything! A child that young, there's no way he survived!
say:5:1521908002:0.source_cn: 你心里难道不清楚吗？洪灾那么严重，被洪水卷走的人根本没...

say:6:1521908003:1.text: If you can't face reality, that's your problem. Asking me over and over won't help.
say:6:1521908003:1.source_cn: 你自己接受不了现实，就算一天问我上百遍也没用！

say:7:1521908004:1.text: Besides, it was the <style="highlight">God of Harvest who sent the flood</style>. It was divine wrath!
say:7:1521908004:1.source_cn: 再说了，带走你儿子的是暴雨，是洪水！那是<style=...

say:8:1521908005:0.text: You want to find your son? Then go ask the God of Harvest yourself! Stop tormenting us!
say:8:1521908005:0.source_cn: 你要找你儿子，那就去找丰饶神！不要天天跑来这里折磨我们！

say:12:1521908008:0.text: I... I've just had enough of this!
say:12:1521908008:0.source_cn: 我……我实在是被烦得不行了！

say:13:1521908009:0.text: That's enough out of you. Just ignore her.
say:13:1521908009:0.source_cn: 行了，别抱怨了。别理她就行了。

say:17:1521908011:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... should we say something to <style="highlight">comfort Nanri</style>?
say:17:1521908011:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... should we say something to <style="highlight">comfort Nanri</style>?
say:17:1521908011:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... should we say something to <style="highlight">comfort Nanri</style>?

say:18:1521908012:1.text: I feel... so sorry for her.
say:18:1521908012:1.male: I feel... so sorry for her.
say:18:1521908012:1.female: I feel... so sorry for her.

narration:20:15021170:0.text: As you and Gala ask the soldier Senu about Nanri, she gets into a quarrel with another soldier.
narration:20:15021170:0.source_cn: 就在你和加拉向士兵塞努打听有关南茜的事时，南茜与另外一...
narration:20:15021170:0.male: As you and Gala ask the soldier Senu about Nanri, she gets into a quarrel with another soldier.
narration:20:15021170:0.female: As you and Gala ask the soldier Senu about Nanri, she gets into a quarrel with another soldier.

say:0:1521909001:0.text: Maybe <style="highlight">some encouraging words could help</style>. Let's at least try.
say:0:1521909001:0.male: Maybe <style="highlight">some encouraging words could help</style>. Let's at least try.
say:0:1521909001:0.female: Maybe <style="highlight">some encouraging words could help</style>. Let's at least try.

say:5:1521910003:1.text:
You... you're mages, right?
You said you saved me with magic...
say:5:1521910003:1.source_cn: 你们……你们是魔法师，对吗？\n你之前说过，是用魔法救...

say:6:1521910004:1.text: Yes. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a powerful mage.
say:6:1521910004:1.male: Yes. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a powerful mage.
say:6:1521910004:1.female: Yes. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a powerful mage.

say:8:1521910005:1.text: Then... can you grant me one wish? Just one. Before I die.
say:8:1521910005:1.source_cn: 你们可以满足我一个愿望吗？就当是……满足我死前最后一个愿望。

choice_prompt:10:1521910005.text: Then... can you grant me one wish? Just one. Before I die.
choice_prompt:10:1521910005.source_cn: 你们可以满足我一个愿望吗？就当是……满足我死前最后一个愿望。

say:12:1521910008:1.text: I just want to go home... To my hometown.
say:12:1521910008:1.source_cn: 我只是想回家……回我的故乡。

say:13:1521910009:1.text: It's gone now, destroyed in the disaster... But I still want to go back one last time. I have precious memories there.
say:13:1521910009:1.source_cn: 虽然它也已经在灾难中毁灭……但我想再回去看看。那里有宝...

choice_prompt:14:1521910009.text: It's gone now, destroyed in the disaster... But I still want to go back one last time. I have precious memories there.
choice_prompt:14:1521910009.source_cn: 虽然它也已经在灾难中毁灭……但我想再回去看看。那里有宝贵的回忆……

say:16:1521910011:1.text: I know it's gone. The God of Harvest destroyed it... Only Marc and I escaped...
say:16:1521910011:1.source_cn: 我知道，图塔镇被丰饶神毁灭了……只有我和马可侥幸逃出来……

say:17:1521910012:1.text: They say it's shrouded in darkness now, crawling with monsters. Anyone who enters disappears... There's no way I could make it back alone.
say:17:1521910012:1.source_cn: 那里已经被黑暗笼罩了……我听说，到处都是怪物，进入黑暗...

say:18:1521910013:1.text: Please, I'm begging you, take me there...
say:18:1521910013:1.source_cn: 所以我想求你们，求你们带我回去……

choice_prompt:19:1521910013.text: Please, I'm begging you, take me there...
choice_prompt:19:1521910013.source_cn: 所以我想求你们，求你们带我回去……

say:21:1521910015:1.text: I'd like to <style="highlight">pick some flowers</style>. To lay at the graves of my husband... and the friends we lost...

choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 好吧，我会送你去图塔镇

choice:19:1:2.text: Okay, but no more suicide attempts.
choice:19:1:2.male: Okay, but no more suicide attempts.
choice:19:1:2.female: Okay, but no more suicide attempts.

say:23:1521910007:1.text: I know... it was the God of Harvest who took him. No mortal could change that...
say:23:1521910007:1.source_cn: 我知道……是丰饶神带走了他。凡人怎么能违抗神呢……

choice:10:1:2.text: I can't bring him back to life.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 我没办法让你儿子起死回生
choice:10:1:2.male: I can't bring him back to life.
choice:10:1:2.female: I can't bring him back to life.

say:0:1521911001:0.text: Tuttleton might not have any flowers left. Let's look nearby first.
say:0:1521911001:0.source_cn: 图塔镇恐怕已经没有花了，先在附近把花采好再过去吧。
say:0:1521911001:0.male: Tuttleton might not have any flowers left. Let's look nearby first.
say:0:1521911001:0.female: Tuttleton might not have any flowers left. Let's look nearby first.

say:0:1521912001:0.text: These flowers are so beautiful... I want to take them back home.
say:0:1521912001:0.source_cn: 这里的花真美……我想把它们带回故乡。

narration:1:1521915001:0.text: You stand a short distance away, saying nothing, quietly keeping Nanri company. You know she needs time to process her feelings alone.
narration:1:1521915001:0.source_cn: 你们站在稍远的地方，一言不发，静静陪伴着南茜。你知道，...

narration:2:1521915002:0.text: After a while, her crying subsides. She straightens up and wipes her tears. She seems a bit calmer now...
narration:2:1521915002:0.source_cn: 不知多久后，南茜的哭声慢慢弱了下去。她直起背，擦干脸上...

say:1:1521916001:0.source_cn: 我的家……我们的房子，麦田……

say:2:1521916002:0.text: Why... why did it have to end like this?
say:2:1521916002:0.source_cn: 为什么……为什么会变成这样……？

choice_prompt:3:1521916002.text: Why... why did it have to end like this?
choice_prompt:3:1521916002.source_cn: 为什么……为什么会变成这样……？

choice:3:0:1.text: Come on. Go lay the flowers.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 打起精神，不是要献花吗
choice:3:0:1.male: Come on. Go lay the flowers.
choice:3:0:1.female: Come on. Go lay the flowers.

say:7:1521916004:0.text: Okay... I'll try to be strong...

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 我们陪你去祭拜亲友吧

say:0:1521917001:0.text: Let's go to the plaza... and lay flowers for those we've lost...
say:0:1521917001:0.source_cn: 我们，去广场上吧……给消失的大家献花……

say:0:1521918001:0.text: This is the plaza in Tuttleton. It used to be the liveliest place in town...
say:0:1521918001:0.source_cn: 这里是图塔镇的广场，曾经是整个小镇最热闹的地方……

say:1:1521918002:0.text: The first bouquet... I'll place it here.
say:1:1521918002:0.source_cn: 第一束花，就放在这里吧……

say:1:1521919001:1.text: This was my favorite place in all of Tuttleton...
say:1:1521919001:1.source_cn: 整个图塔镇，我最喜欢的就是这个广场……

say:2:1521919002:1.text: During sowing season, my friends and I would sit in the sun, chatting for hours... When the days got too hot, we'd pick a cool night to sing and dance under the stars...
say:2:1521919002:1.source_cn: 播种的季节，我和朋友会在这里晒着太阳，聊聊天……天气热...

say:3:1521919003:1.text: After the harvest, the whole plaza would be covered in golden wheat. Towns from all around came to collect it, their wagons arriving one after another to haul the grain away...
say:3:1521919003:1.source_cn: 丰收以后，广场就晒满了麦子，金灿灿的。周围的城镇都来我...

say:4:1521919004:1.text: It was here that I met <style="highlight">Elio</style>. We fell in love... and built a life together...
say:4:1521919004:1.source_cn: 我也是在这里认识的<style=highlight>埃...

narration:5:1521919005:0.text: Nanri begins to recall her memories.

say:8:1521919006:1.text: Nanri! How are you feeling today? Any discomfort?
say:8:1521919006:1.source_cn: 南茜！今天感觉怎么样，身体有没有什么不舒服的地方？

say:9:1521919007:1.text: You're such a worrier... I've just been out in the plaza, getting some sun. What could happen? You're the one working all day. Look at you, your face is covered in sweat... Don't push yourself too hard.
say:9:1521919007:1.source_cn: 你真是个操心的爸爸……我每天就在广场上晒晒太阳，能有什...

say:10:1521919008:1.text: Look at you, your face is dripping with sweat... Did you finish cutting the wheat? You must be exhausted.
say:10:1521919008:1.source_cn: 瞧瞧你，脸上都是汗……麦子都割完了吧，累不累？

say:11:1521919009:1.text: Not at all! Just knowing that a few extra bundles could buy our child another toy or a new outfit... that gives me all the strength I need!
say:11:1521919009:1.source_cn: 这有什么！一想到只要多收几捧麦子，就能给咱们的孩子多买...

say:12:1521919010:1.text: With a dad like you, Marc or Rhea is going to be one lucky kid.
say:12:1521919010:1.source_cn: 有你这么好的爸爸，马可或者瑞娅一定会很开心的。

say:13:1521919011:1.text: Marc? Rhea? Are those the names you picked?
say:13:1521919011:1.source_cn: 马可？瑞娅？这是你给孩子起的名字吗？

say:14:1521919012:0.text: Yeah. Marc if it's a boy, Rhea if it's a girl.
say:14:1521919012:0.source_cn: 是啊。如果是男孩就叫马可，如果是女孩，就叫瑞娅。

say:15:1521919013:1.text: There used to be two devoted priests in town by those names. I hope our child will be blessed by the God of Harvest, just like they were.
say:15:1521919013:1.source_cn: 咱们镇上以前有两位很虔诚的祭司，他们就叫这两个名字。我...

say:16:1521919014:0.text: They will be! <style="highlight">This is Tuttleton, after all. The God of Harvest watches over this place!</style>
say:16:1521919014:0.source_cn: 放心吧，一定会的！这里可是<style=highlig...

say:19:1521919015:0.text: I really thought... those days would last forever...
say:19:1521919015:0.source_cn: 我以为……我以为那样的日子会永远持续下去……

say:20:1521919016:0.text: So why... why did the God of Harvest fall?
say:20:1521919016:0.source_cn: 可是为什么……为什么丰饶神会神堕……

say:0:1521920001:0.text: Let's put the next bouquet on the altar...

say:0:1521921001:0.text: It's a big altar. Everyone in Tuttleton helped build it. But the god...
say:0:1521921001:0.source_cn: 这座祭坛这么大，每一个图塔人都参与了它的建设。可是神啊...

say:1:1521921002:0.text: I'm not offering him flowers anymore. This bouquet... it's for the ones we lost.
say:1:1521921002:0.source_cn: 我不会再为神献花了。这第二束花……献给在灾难中死去的人。

say:1:1521922001:1.text: When the God of Harvest first came, everyone in town felt honored. We fought over who would bring offerings of light to him.
say:1:1521922001:1.source_cn: 丰饶神降临那天，每个图塔镇的人都为神降感到荣幸，争着要...

say:2:1521922002:1.text: But then... we started noticing something strange about him...
say:2:1521922002:1.source_cn: 但渐渐，大家发现了他的古怪之处……

narration:3:1521922003:0.text: Nanri begins to recall her memories.

say:5:1521922004:1.text: Don't you think it's strange? The God of Harvest used to love sunlight. So why...
say:5:1521922004:1.source_cn: 你们觉不觉得有点不对劲？丰饶神明明那么热爱阳光，为什么...

say:7:1521922005:1.text: Shh! Quiet, Nanri. Keep it to yourself. Don't say it out loud.
say:7:1521922005:1.source_cn: 嘘！小点声，南茜。你心里知道是怎么回事就好了，不要说出来。

say:8:1521922006:1.text: But... are we really going to hold that ritual, just because he told us to?
say:8:1521922006:1.source_cn: 可是……难道我们真的要按他说的，举办祭祀吗？

say:9:1521922007:1.text: Don't worry. The priests have a plan.
say:9:1521922007:1.source_cn: 别担心，祭司们已经想到了办法。

say:10:1521922008:1.text: ... They're going to use the ritual to drive him out of town, once and for all.
say:10:1521922008:1.source_cn: ……他们打算利用这次的祭祀仪式，将他彻底赶出镇子。

say:12:1521922010:1.text: Even if it is, we have to protect our home.
say:12:1521922010:1.source_cn: 不管多危险，我们都得守卫家园。

say:13:1521922011:1.text: The priests are planning to evacuate all the children before the ritual. To avoid drawing attention, they'll leave in three groups.
say:13:1521922011:1.source_cn: 祭司们打算在仪式开始前把镇上的孩子都送走。为了避免被发...

say:14:1521922012:1.text: I got you and Marc into the first group... so you'll need to start packing right away.
say:14:1521922012:1.source_cn: 我替你和马可争取到了第一批……所以你们要尽快收拾行李了。

say:15:1521922013:1.text: But what about you? We can't leave you behind!
say:15:1521922013:1.source_cn: 可是你怎么办？我们不能没有你啊！

say:16:1521922014:1.text: Don't worry. Trust me, the ritual will work.
say:16:1521922014:1.source_cn: 别紧张，相信我，仪式一定会成功的。

say:17:1521922015:1.text: Once he's gone, I'll come get you. And then, we won't have to live in fear anymore. Sound good?
say:17:1521922015:1.source_cn: 等他离开了，我就去接你们回来。到时候我们就不用担惊受怕...

say:20:1521922016:1.text: So much for that... the plan failed.
say:20:1521922016:1.source_cn: 你们看……计划还是失败了。

say:21:1521922017:0.text: Elio... I'll never see him again. Or my parents... or my friends...
say:21:1521922017:0.source_cn: 埃利奥……我再也见不到他，见不到我的父母和朋友了……

say:22:1521922018:0.text: If it weren't for Marc, I probably would've given up a long time ago...
say:22:1521922018:0.source_cn: 如果不是还有马可，恐怕我早就已经坚持不下去了……

say:23:1521922019:1.text: I... I just wanted to protect him. Tuttleton is gone. All that's left are the kids who barely made it out...
say:23:1521922019:1.source_cn: 我……我只想保护好马可！图塔镇没了，只剩下他们这些好不...

say:24:1521922020:1.text: And even then, the flood... that flood the God of Harvest sent! He still took Marc away from me!
say:24:1521922020:1.source_cn: 可即便这样，洪水……丰饶神降下的洪水！他还是把马可从我...

say:25:1521922021:1.text: I... I can't go on. I've lost everything...
say:25:1521922021:1.source_cn: 我……我真的撑不住了，我什么都没有了……

say:26:1521922022:1.text: I... I just want it all to <style="highlight">end</style>.

say:0:1521923001:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... is she thinking of ending her life again?
say:0:1521923001:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... is she thinking of ending her life again?
say:0:1521923001:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... is she thinking of ending her life again?

say:1:1521923002:0.text: Stay close to her. Don't let her do anything foolish.
say:1:1521923002:0.male: Stay close to her. Don't let her do anything foolish.
say:1:1521923002:0.female: Stay close to her. Don't let her do anything foolish.

say:3:1521926002:1.text: Renee... oh, sweetheart... why are you still here?
say:3:1521926002:1.source_cn: 蕾妮，蕾妮……可怜的孩子，你怎么还在这里？

say:4:1521926003:1.text: Your mother told me you'd be with the last evacuation group... You didn't make it out?
say:4:1521926003:1.source_cn: 我明明记得你妈妈和我说过，你们会在最后撤离的那支队伍里...

say:6:1521926005:1.text: After we left town, it got dark... then Mom grabbed my hand and started running...
say:6:1521926005:1.source_cn: 妈妈带我离开镇子以后，天就黑了……然后，然后妈妈就拉着...

say:7:1521926006:1.text: But so many people were falling! Mom... Mom fell too! She couldn't stand up... she crawled on the ground, just like... just like those monsters chasing me earlier...!
say:7:1521926006:1.source_cn: 但是好多人都摔倒了！妈妈……妈妈也摔倒了！她站不起来，...

choice_prompt:8:1521926006.text: But so many people were falling! Mom... Mom fell too! She couldn't stand up... she crawled on the ground, just like... just like those monsters chasing me earlier...!
choice_prompt:8:1521926006.source_cn: 但是好多人都摔倒了！妈妈……妈妈也摔倒了！她站不起来，就在地上爬，像……像刚才追我的那些怪物一样……！

say:9:1521926007:1.text: Then how... how did you get away?
say:9:1521926007:1.source_cn: 那你……你是怎么从这里逃出去的？

say:10:1521926008:1.text: They saved me... They couldn't speak anymore, but they still remembered me... They pushed me out...
say:10:1521926008:1.source_cn: 是大家救了我……大家虽然说不出话了，但还记得我……是他...

say:14:1521926010:1.text: They pushed you into the light. That's why the corruption didn't reach you.
say:14:1521926010:1.source_cn: 是那些人把你推出了黑暗，所以你才没有受到神堕的影响。

say:15:1521926011:1.text: I don't know... I just kept running and running, until I found a house...
say:15:1521926011:1.source_cn: 不知道……我只知道我跑了好久好久，才找到一间房子……

say:16:1521926012:1.text: There was a kind old woman living there. She gave me food, clothes... But later, there was nothing left to eat. And then... she too...
say:16:1521926012:1.source_cn: 那里住着一个奶奶，她给我吃的，给我衣服……可是后来，就...

say:18:1521926013:1.text: I... I didn't know where to go. I just wanted to find Mom and Dad... but they were gone. Tuttleton was gone too!
say:18:1521926013:1.source_cn: 我……我没有地方去，所以想找妈妈，找爸爸……但是他们都...

say:19:1521926014:1.text: Aunt Nanri, where are they? I want to see them... *Sobbing*
say:19:1521926014:1.source_cn: 南茜阿姨，爸爸妈妈在哪？我想找他们……呜呜呜……

say:21:1521926015:1.text: Poor Renee... Aunt Nanri's right here...
say:21:1521926015:1.source_cn: 可怜的蕾妮，南茜阿姨在这……

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 那些镇民被神堕影响了……

say:0:1521927001:0.text: Sigh, let's try to comfort them.
say:0:1521927001:0.source_cn: 唉……还是安慰一下她们吧。
say:0:1521927001:0.male: Sigh, let's try to comfort them.
say:0:1521927001:0.female: Sigh, let's try to comfort them.

say:1:1521928001:1.text:
Try to stay strong.
This place isn't safe. We need to leave quickly.
say:1:1521928001:1.source_cn: 请振作一点，别再哭了。\n这里不是很安全，要尽快离开才行。

say:3:1521928003:1.text:
Renee, would you like to come to Halia?
... And stay with Aunt Nanri?
say:3:1521928003:1.source_cn: 蕾妮，你想不想去呼临城？\n……和南茜阿姨一起生活。

say:6:1521928005:1.text: Halia... Is it safe there? Is it nice, like Tuttleton was?
say:6:1521928005:1.source_cn: 呼临城……那里安全吗？像图塔镇一样好吗……？

say:7:1521928006:1.text: Maybe not like Tuttleton... but you'll be with me. You won't have to run or hide anymore.
say:7:1521928006:1.source_cn: 可能没有图塔镇那么好……但是你可以和我在一起，不用再颠...

say:8:1521928007:1.text: The war is over. The famine too. We'll have a roof over our heads, warm meals...You'll grow up safe...
say:8:1521928007:1.source_cn: 战争和饥荒都结束了……我们会有房子，会有食物，你可以平...

say:9:1521928008:1.text: And when you're older... maybe we can return to Tuttleton.
say:9:1521928008:1.source_cn: 等你长大以后……或许我们就可以再回到图塔镇了。

say:10:1521928009:1.text: You won't leave me, will you? Not like Mom and Dad?
say:10:1521928009:1.source_cn: 南茜阿姨，你不会离开我的，不会像爸爸妈妈那样……对吗？

say:12:1521928011:1.text: Then... then I want to go to Halia! I want to stay with you, Aunt Nanri!
say:12:1521928011:1.source_cn: 那……那我愿意去呼临城！和南茜阿姨一起！

say:14:1521928013:1.text: Then I'll take you to <style="highlight">Halia</style>... To our future home.

say:17:1521928014:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Nanri won't try to end her life again, will she?
say:17:1521928014:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Nanri won't try to end her life again, will she?
say:17:1521928014:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Nanri won't try to end her life again, will she?

choice_prompt:18:1521928014.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Nanri won't try to end her life again, will she?

say:20:1521928016:0.text: It started out so tragic... but I'm glad it ended this way.
say:20:1521928016:0.source_cn: 虽然是由一个悲伤的故事开头……但我喜欢这个结尾。
say:20:1521928016:0.male: It started out so tragic... but I'm glad it ended this way.
say:20:1521928016:0.female: It started out so tragic... but I'm glad it ended this way.

choice:18:0:1.text: You can see it, can't you?
choice:18:0:1.male: You can see it, can't you?
choice:18:0:1.female: You can see it, can't you?

say:0:1521929001:0.text: Come on, Nanri. Let's take you and Renee back to Halia.
say:0:1521929001:0.source_cn: 走吧，南茜。我们送你和蕾妮回呼临城。
say:0:1521929001:0.male: Come on, Nanri. Let's take you and Renee back to Halia.
say:0:1521929001:0.female: Come on, Nanri. Let's take you and Renee back to Halia.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1521901001:.text: Let me end all of this...

narration:2:1521901201:0.text: You cast your spell just in time, pulling the woman back from the edge of the cliff.
narration:2:1521901201:0.source_cn: 你施展魔法，将跳下悬崖的女人救了回来

say:1:1521930001:0.text: So this is Halia? It's not quite like how Mom and Dad described it...
say:1:1521930001:0.source_cn: 这里就是呼临城吗？和爸爸妈妈说的不太一样……

say:2:1521930002:0.text: Don't be scared, Renee. I'm right here.

say:3:1521930003:1.text: Mm... As long as you're with me, Aunt Nanri, I'm not scared!
say:3:1521930003:1.source_cn: 嗯……有南茜阿姨在，我不怕！

choice_prompt:4:1521930003.text: Mm... As long as you're with me, Aunt Nanri, I'm not scared!
choice_prompt:4:1521930003.source_cn: 嗯……有南茜阿姨在，我不怕！

say:5:1521930005:1.text: Thank you... Thank you for saving me.
say:5:1521930005:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们……谢谢你们救了我。

say:6:1521930006:0.text: I'll take good care of Renee. She's the last hope of Tuttleton... and mine too.
say:6:1521930006:0.source_cn: 我会一定会好好照顾好蕾妮……她是图塔镇的希望，也是我的希望。

say:7:1521930007:0.text: When she's older, I'll try to tell her everything about Tuttleton. Maybe one day... Tuttleton will return...
say:7:1521930007:0.source_cn: 如果可以，等她长大以后，我会给她讲更多图塔镇的故事。也...

cinematic_dialogue:10:1521931001:.text: Do they grow wheat here, too?

narration:12:15021131:0.text: Nanri takes Renee back to Halia to begin a new life...
narration:12:15021131:0.source_cn: 南茜带着蕾妮回到呼临城，开始了她们的新生活……

say:13:1521930004:0.text: I understand... Don't worry. I won't go down that path again.
say:13:1521930004:0.source_cn: 我明白……你们放心，我不会再做那种事了。
